defects.detail: Bottom-right box reads 'Ref. Plog. TJC-LLD-PID-XXXX'; datasheet, GA drawing and C&E cross-reference TJC-LLD-PID-7801.
NOTE 2 cites 'Datasheet TJC-LLD-DS-GA-7801A'; CT-7801's datasheet is TJC-LLD-DS-CT-7801.
GA-1201A instruments FI 1201, PT-1201 and PSLL 1201 drawn at the fan gearbox.

'Gearbox oil temp | TSHH-7802 | =90 dag C' where C&E T2 is TSHH-7803 > 90 degC, and its final element is 'Annunciate Alarm on DCS' where the C&E trips the fan (EFF-1, EFF-2, EFF-3); a second 'Fan vibration | VSHH-7802' row carries '=90 dag C'; the hub bubble reads 'VSIFH-7802'; effect cells of row 1 read '1 | X̄ | T1 T2 T3 T4'; 'Spare Coil CT-7802' for C&E 'SPARE CELL CT-7802'; the permissive list mixes LT-7804 and LSL-7804 and adds 'L Gearbox oil level OK < Other (LSL-7804)'.
'Ref. Plog.', 'IDlimitator', 'test/act.', '=90 dag C', 'LOGIC hum/', '( per image_0.png)', '(as in <IMAGE 1>)', 'Lockout release logic in orllf per image_0.png', 'Drainess Drain'.
No title block; the sheet has the caption 'P&ID: COOLING TOWER FAN (CT-7801) SYSTEM' bottom-left and the Ref. Plog. box only.
